name: IEX_DUNNINGS
description: Holds data on all dunning transactions sent by the system.

columns.name: DUNNING_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description:
Concurrent Program who column.
Identifies the concurrent program
fnd_global.conc_program_name

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description:
Identifies the Application name spawning the Concurrent Request.
fnd_global.prog_appl_name

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS table.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HZ_SITE_USES_ALL table.

columns.name: XML_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the request made to publisher engine.

columns.name: XML_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifies what letter template is used by this plan detail.

columns.name: LETTER_NAME
columns.description: Dunning letter name.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the dunning.

columns.name: CALLBACK_YN
columns.description: This indicates if a follow up call should be automatically created by the application if the delinquency is not cured after the letter is received.

columns.name: CALLBACK_DATE
columns.description: Scheduled dunning callback date.

columns.name: DUNNING_METHOD
columns.description: What method did we use to send dunning.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING
columns.description: Amount due remaining on the delinquency.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amount remaining.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type (customer, account or site) that has been dunned.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the object type.

columns.name: DUNNING_LEVEL
columns.description: Indicates the dunning level this record was created against.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_CHARGE
columns.description: Amount of the finance charge on this dunning.

columns.name: INTEREST_AMT
columns.description: Amount of interest charged in the dunning letter.

columns.name: DUNNING_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the IEX_DUNNING_PLANS_B table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DESTINATION
columns.description: Contact who received the dunning.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the contact who received the dunning.

columns.name: PARTY_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the location of dunned customer.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Dunning delivery status.

columns.name: PARENT_DUNNING_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the parent record of the dunning.

columns.name: XML_DATA
columns.description: This column will store the XML data used to generate the dunning so it can be re-generated.
